name: – Gheorghe Falcă – After § 24 – Am 31
title: REPORT on the deliberations of the Committee on Petitions in 2023
part_text: 24a. Recalls the significant number of petitions submitted by EU citizens highlighting abuses committed by the Commission and Member State authorities during the COVID-19 pandemic; regrets that the PETI Committee has failed to follow up with meaningful actions, leaving citizens unheard and unprotected during these unprecedented times; underlines that this lack of response undermines citizens’ trust in and the accountability they rightfully expect from the EU institutions in addressing such serious concerns;
